name: usage-monitor
description: Reports allowance meters (status line) and request workload (OpenTelemetry) to a self-hosted usage monitor. Metadata only: no prompts, code, or tokens leave the machine.

server_url.title: Monitor server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the usage monitor, e.g. https://monitor.example.com

enrollment_code.title: Enrollment code
enrollment_code.description: Single-use code from the monitor dashboard. Used once on first start; expires after 15 minutes.
